en.headline: 20-month-old infant in critical condition after influenza A and septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating the case of a previously healthy boy who developed fever and convulsions; he remains in paediatric intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: A 20-month-old boy who was previously in good health is in critical condition after contracting influenza A complicated by septic shock, the Centre for Health Protection said on Monday.

The infant developed a fever on 7 August and was taken to a private clinic the next day. He suffered convulsions at the clinic and was immediately sent to Queen Elizabeth Hospital’s accident and emergency department, where low blood pressure was found. He was admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A.

He had not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine and had no travel history during the incubation period. One household contact tested positive for influenza but recovered without hospitalisation. The centre said this is the seventh severe paediatric influenza case since the season began in late June, including one death, and activity is expected to remain high in the coming weeks.

zh.headline: 20個月大男嬰染甲流併發敗血性休克危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，男嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情况危殆。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周一公布，正調查一宗兒童感染甲型流感的嚴重個案，涉及一名過往健康良好的20個月大男嬰。
男嬰於8月7日起出現發燒，翌日被帶到私家診所求醫，在診所期間抽搐，即時送往伊利沙伯醫院急症室，檢查發現血壓偏低，獲安排入住兒童深切治療部。呼吸道樣本證實對甲型流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克，目前情况危殆。
初步調查顯示，男嬰未接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，潛伏期內無外遊。其中一名家居接觸者近日出現上呼吸道症狀，快速抗原檢測呈陽性，但病况輕微已康復。中心指自6月底進入流感季節以來，連同本個案累計七宗兒童嚴重個案，其中一宗死亡，預料活躍程度未來數周仍會維持高水平。
